title.narrative: A Private Public Partnership Project: Training Academy in Heavy Duty Equipment and Commercial Vehicles in Ethiopia

description.narrative: The overall objective of this project is to improve Ethiopian youths' access to gainful employment opportunities in advanced commercial vehicle maintenance through high-tech training and thereby contribute to the poverty reduction effort in the country. The project will transform the local training service provider Selam Technical Training Institute in Addis Ababa by setting up a modern, well-equipped training centre for heavy duty commercial vehicles at the Selam premises outside Addis Ababa, transforming an existing training workshop into a modern academy which integrates auto mechanics, electronics and hydraulics with strong emphasis on computer skills.
